names: Cyclamic acid and its sodium and calcium salts, also known as Cyclamate
display_name: E952 (Cyclamic acid and its sodium and calcium salts)

more_info.banned_in:
Banned in: United States.
Approved in the EU.
The US prohibition follows the 1969 cyclamate order.
more_info.overview: Cyclamic acid and its sodium and calcium salts is used as a sweetener in food. Its technological role is to provide sweetness.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include meal replacement for weight control as referred to in Commission Regulation (EU) no 432/2012, flavoured drinks, flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products, canned or bottled fruit and vegetables. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
